issues.reason: The whenever machinery mints 'a Skolem event per occurrence' keyed on the trigger (the shown (sk_bark $x)), and a dependent existential must be 'a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it' — (sk_turn $s) / (sk_residue $s) ignore the gathering $e, so one turn event would sit During two distinct gatherings of the same bloom.

gaps_confirmed: 'at the half moon' — a recurring lunar phase as a temporal adjunct has no Time form (the section covers calendar/clock terms, deictic constants, day-parts and named times only), so whether it is a bare Time symbol, implies a cycle, or takes a genus like room_temperature is unspecified
new_gaps: change-of-kind result whose kind is a modified NP ('turns to chalky residue'): the State-result shape shows only a single-word result kind on the state witness, so whether the descriptive modifier also types the state witness (as here) or only the subject is unspecified

a demonstrative NP in the consequent ('that salt-bloom') binding a bare mass object of the trigger clause: donkey anaphora covers a pronoun bound inside a relative clause, not a bare mass object promoted to a premise variable with its own Member atom
defect_summary: Key the response on the trigger occurrence — (Member (sk_turn $e) turn) (Patient (sk_turn $e) $s), the result state (sk_residue $e) with $s as its Experiencer (or functions of $k $s $e), (Result (sk_turn $e) (sk_residue $e)) and (During (sk_turn $e) $e); the change-of-kind shape itself (subject as Patient, reified state with the same subject as Experiencer, flat copular halves, Result link, no separate entity) is per doctrine and stands.
notes: 'a Keeper' as the common-noun kind keeper with no Name and no capability atom (referring use), salt_bloom with genus bloom only, the tenseless habitual and the absent QuantifierPhrase all follow the instruction set.
